problem: Current collector holds full transport archive plus chunks before retiring transport, then Git/mirror persist another compressed representation. Local headroom is below the existing measured collection guard.
proposed_transport: Read exact remote archive as a bounded SSH byte stream into exclusive fresh48MiB chunk files.
Hash entire stream and each chunk, enforce exact released total byte ceiling, retain partial chunks and failure receipt without retry.
After whole archive SHA/size passes, expose concatenated chunk reader to streaming tar parser; verify every unique regular member, complete original ledger, safe path and exact metadata policy.
Keep all original JSONL in archive; expand only released measured metadata set.
Write final retention receipt only after all checks; retain remote originals until independent source/mirror/archive proof and separate cleanup release.

space_accounting.transport_peak: A + measured metadata + bounded one-chunk RAM buffer; no full transport file
space_accounting.durability_peak: Working chunks A plus Git source/mirror object growth must remain reserved explicitly; direct streaming alone does not justify changing2A toA for the complete collection-and-backup transaction.
space_accounting.next_requirement: Derive conservative Git/mirror growth allowance from actual compression/object sharing or split transport and backup guards with no claim of durable completion until both pass.

decision: Prefer legitimate duplicate cooling or a fully justified end-to-end storage bound; do not silently lower current2A guard.
